_README: Items the mechanical gap check flags that have been VERIFIED IN THE RUNNING APP against
the spec and found not to be defects. _gap_check.py reports these as ADJUDICATED rather
than MISSING, so a later pass reads the verdict instead of re-investigating.
Every entry below was checked by opening the real screen, as a role that can open it, and
reading the spec section named on the item. The reason field says what was found.
Add an entry ONLY after verifying in the browser. This file exists to stop re-litigation,
not to silence findings — a wrong entry here hides a real defect permanently. If the app
changes such that one of these becomes true again, delete the entry.
Key format: '<screen section> :: <item text>', matched exactly as the report prints them.
3.4 Leave Types :: Paid or Unpaid: PRESENT. The list column header reads 'Paid / Unpaid' (leave-types.list.config.ts) — the spec's own wording — and the form renders it as a required checkbox 'Paid Leave' whose hint states 'On = Paid, off = Unpaid'. A checkbox rather than a dropdown is deliberate: the API field is a real boolean is_paid, and a select would bind the strings 'true'/'false' into a bool column.
3.6 Company Profile :: Save Changes: PRESENT. The caption is set via SingletonFormConfig.submitLabel, which the checker does not read. Verified rendering as 'Save Changes' beside 'Discard Changes'.
